description: React component for an interactive chessboard in a chess learning frontend. Implements user interactions, move handling, and visual indicators on the chessboard.

methods.name: toCoord(fileIndex, rankIndex)
methods.description: Helper function that converts file and rank indices into algebraic chess notation coordinates (e.g., 'a1').

methods.name: ChessBoard({ engine, allowedMoves })
methods.description: Main React component rendering an interactive chessboard, handling user interactions, move logic, and visual state indicators.

methods.name: handleSquareClick
methods.description: Event handler for clicking on a square; manages selection and move attempts based on user input.
